title: The God of Angel Armies
lyrics_original: You hear me when I call
You are my sword and shield
I know who goes before me
He is a friend of mine
My strength is in Your name
Whom shall I fear || I know ||
And nothing formed against me shall stand
You hold the whole world in Your hands
I'm holding on to Your promises
author_english: Chris Tomlin, Ed Cash, Scott Cash

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా నాకు వెలుగును రక్షణయునైయున్నాడు, నేను ఎవరికి భయపడుదును? యెహోవా నా ప్రాణదుర్గము, ఎవరికి వెరతును?
bible_verses.english: The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—of whom shall I be afraid?

bible_verses.telugu: సమాధాన కర్తయగు దేవుడు సాతానును మీ కాళ్లక్రింద శీఘ్రముగా చితుక త్రొక్కించును. మన ప్రభువైన యేసుక్రీస్తు కృప మీకు తోడై యుండును గాక.
bible_verses.english: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా నా శైలము, నా కోట, నన్ను రక్షించు వాడునా కేడెము, నా రక్షణ శృంగము, నా ఉన్నతదుర్గము, నా దేవుడునేను ఆశ్రయించియున్న నా దుర్గము.
bible_verses.english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, thank You for hearing my call even when my voice feels weak. When troubles linger and fear creeps in, remind me that You are my strength, my light, and my defender. I place my worries into Your almighty hands and trust that You go before me. Fill my heart with Your peace today as I rest in Your unfailing love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, thank You for hearing my call even when my voice feels weak. When troubles linger and fear creeps in, remind me that You are my strength, my light, and my defender. I place my worries into Your almighty hands and trust that You go before me. Fill my heart with Your peace today as I rest in Your unfailing love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: In our darkest nights and toughest battles, it is easy to feel overwhelmed by the shadows around us. Yet this song reminds us that the God who commands heaven's armies listens closely to our softest prayer and stands as our unshakable shield. Because Jesus has defeated darkness once and for all, we do not have to face tomorrow in our own strength. Today, let your heart rest in His victorious love and step forward with quiet confidence.
